scientific_integrity: The result follows from a proof for all positive integer run lengths; independent dynamic-programming finite tests are supporting checks, not an infinite proof. The literature comparison is qualified by possible unindexed equivalent work.
scientific_limitations: The exact length formula applies only to circular binary words with exactly four positive runs; the sharp 3/4 minimum applies only when zero and one frequencies agree. It does not solve the general circular antipalindromic subsequence conjecture, count longest solutions, or establish independent literature priority.
title: A sharp three-quarter antipalindromic subsequence law for four-run circular binary words
